/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/koi-nahin-husain-ka.md\")
original = path.read_bytes()
metadata, verses = original.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
roman, source = verses.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
updated = roman.decode()
for before, after in {
    \"Ghazi\": \"Ghaazi\",
    \"Wa ghurbata ae wa ghurbata\": \"Wa ghurbataa ae wa ghurbataa\",
    \"sada thi\": \"thi sada\",
    \"sada\": \"sadaa\",
    \"luta\": \"lutaa\",
    \"Bacha ke\": \"Bachaa ke\",
    \"Khuda\": \"Khudaa\",
    \"Laashe utha\": \"Laashe uthaa\",
    \"aansu baha\": \"aaṅsu bahaa\",
    \"Husain ya Husain\": \"Husain yaa Husain\",
    \"musibata\": \"musibataa\",
    \"Nana tera\": \"Naana tera\",
}.items():
    updated = updated.replace(before, after)

result = metadata + b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + updated.encode() + b\"\\n---\\n\" + source
roman_blocks = updated.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
source_blocks = source.decode().strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 14
for number, (roman_block, source_block) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    roman_lines = roman_block.strip().splitlines()
    source_lines = source_block.splitlines()
    assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines) == (5 if number else 2)
    if number:
        assert roman_lines[0] == str(number)
        assert source_lines[0] == str(number).translate(str.maketrans(\"0123456789\", \"۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\"))
assert set(updated) - set(map(chr, range(128))) <= {\"ṅ\"}
path.write_bytes(result)

item.text:
Audited all 54 Roman verses against the Urdu. Corrected stanza 13’s word order to `Zainab ki thi sadaa` and normalized long vowels and nasal spelling, including `Ghaazi`, `lutaa`, and `aaṅsu`.

Verified alignment across the opening and all 13 stanzas. The Urdu text and metadata were preserved. Human editorial sign-off is still pending.
